name: Muttart Conservatory
geometry_source: OpenStreetMap API, relation 17644228 full, and the map extract for the building:part ways, read 2026-10-14
plan_length_note: plan_length_m is a horizontal WGS84 length, haversine, sphere radius 6378137 m, one decimal. On a ring it is the perimeter of that ring. edge_m, where present, is each mapped side of that ring in node order, the same length. The named pyramid rings are not four-sided squares. A mapped side is not a published base side. map_distance_to_stop_m is the horizontal distance from the stop node 53.53621, -113.48000 to the nearest point on that ring. It is not a clearance. The centre of this file is the area-weighted centre of the four outer rings of relation 17644228. The areas used for that centre are not stored. They are not the published floor areas. No elevations are stored. OpenStreetMap height tags are copied under tags. They are not a surveyed height.

reference_point.name: Muttart stop
reference_point.which: The stop node in lrt-tracks.json, and the centre in the Muttart stop geometry. The conservatory is placed against this node. A map_distance_to_stop_m is a horizontal map distance. It is not a clearance.

complex.which: One multipolygon tagged name=Muttart Conservatory and building=greenhouse. Four outer rings. No inner rings. This is the named complex. It is not four pyramid footprints. The pyramid footprints are the separate building:part ways.

rings.which: Closed ring. Eastern outer member of relation 17644228. The way is tagged leisure=garden. The relation is tagged building=greenhouse. This ring contains the main entrance. It is not a pyramid footprint. plan_length_m is the perimeter. Node order follows the way, and the first node is repeated at the end.

Closed ring. Western outer member of relation 17644228. The way is tagged building=greenhouse. This is the ring nearest the stop node. It is not a pyramid footprint, and it is not named as a pyramid. plan_length_m is the perimeter. Node order follows the way, and the first node is repeated at the end.

Closed ring. Outer member of relation 17644228. The way has no tags. It sits just north of the other untagged ring, at the south side of the western ring. It is not a display pyramid. A pyramid name was not assigned. plan_length_m is the perimeter.

entrance.which: Tagged entrance=main, door=sliding, wheelchair=yes. It lies on the eastern ring and on the grass-roof part. East side of the pyramid group.

pyramids.which: Name is the OpenStreetMap name tag. It was not assigned from size. Of the four named parts, this centre is the northern one. The height tag is 24 and the roof:height tag is 20.
